description: Get the Gmail sending status of one mailbox (the workspace default, or the one named by mailbox_id): connected account, auto-send on/off, daily cap, how many sent today, remaining budget today, how many emails it has queued, and estimated days to drain them. It also returns mailboxes: every connected Gmail mailbox with its own account, cap and queue. Each website sends from the mailbox it is mapped to, or from the default one.

mailbox_id.description: A mailbox_id from the mailboxes list. Omit it for the workspace default mailbox.

name: outreach_sending_status
